name: UF-ega-isometric-room
note: Isometric grid: edges snap to 2:1 pixel-iso lines + verticals. Best with 'isometric' in the prompt. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/ega-isometric-room.  (sample: seed 1091)

form.subject: (isometric view:1.4) of a small (stone dungeon room:1.2), a (treasure chest:1.2), torches, a wooden door
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border, (flat frontal elevation:1.2)

sample_command: pixelmon '(isometric view:1.4) of a small (stone dungeon room:1.2), a (treasure chest:1.2), torches, a wooden door, ega_art, EGA 16-color pixel art, scene background, role-playing game, 1980s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora ega-art-v2.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border, (flat frontal elevation:1.2)' --style scene --out 320x200 --palette EGA --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 3 --pixel-angles 1.5 --angle-grid isometric --seed 1091
